description: ADDITIVE permission set for the Connectors settings panel (label panel-settings-connectors, registry kind 'settings.connectors'). The panel-* glob in panels.json already grants native window movement plus open-external-url for the OAuth browser hop; this capability adds the client-brokered OAuth loopback commands the connector consent flow needs. Scoped to this panel so other settings panels do not inherit the loopback surface.
